name: Cutie query-adapted SAM2 memory read
status: Exploratory PolypGen development pilot; freeze before launch
scope: PolypGen and all its sequences informed previous work. Seq16-23 are a sequence split for this pilot, not an untouched external test or verified patient-independent cohort.
method: Keep SAM2 image encoder, memory writer, decoder, frame schedule, spatial tokens and pointer path native. At each of four memory attention layers, pool stored predicted-memory values by the predicted-mask foreground, mixed-boundary and background labels. Use these prototypes as three Cutie object queries that refine the native read and current SAM2 query map. Add a bounded residual to native attention output. Reuse one official pretrained Cutie QueryTransformerBlock across SAM2 layers and freeze it; train the shared input/output projections plus per-layer region-query embeddings and residual scales.

provenance.adaptation: Cutie's pretrained block is author code; the SAM2 feature bridge and residual placement are this project's adaptation.

model.memory_and_pointer_behavior: No memory keys are removed or selected; pointer K/V stay in native SDPA and are not included in the three region prototypes.

data.sampling: Pinned SAM2 RandomUniformSampler; clips start with a positive mask, are 5 frames long, and each clip writes its predicted masks/features to memory.

scope: Exploratory sequence-split PolypGen pilot; prior analyses included all sequences; no independent patient or dataset claim.

training.loss: Mean post-prompt decoder mask loss plus object-presence loss over each sampled clip; SAM2 and the Cutie query-transformer block remain frozen.
training.sampling_control: All arms train on identical clips and schedules. Shuffled permutes predicted-mask region labels within each stored frame, preserving counts. Generic repeats the global memory mean for all three queries.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice across seq16-23.
evaluation.pilot_signal: Call it a positive pilot signal only if region-aware exceeds both native and shuffled mean Dice by at least 0.01 and is higher than native on at least 6/8 sequences, with no increase in total false-alarm frames. This is a screening criterion, not statistical confirmation.

decision: First pass the real seq2/seq3 engineering workflow gate. Then run this fixed one-seed pilot once. Do not tune on seq16-23. Any observed gain remains exploratory; an independent dataset and repeated seeds are required before claiming a reliable method.
